Introduction

unevermet, also stylized as uneverm8t, is the first subunit of the boy group idntt. The subunit consists of Kim DoHun, Kim HeeJu, Choi TaeIn, Lee JaeYoung, Kim JuHo, Nam JiWoon, and Lee HwanHee. Originally including HwangBo MinGyeol, he was removed from the subunit on July 21, 2025.

The unit made their debut on August 11, 2025, with their first mini album "unevermet".
